description: This routine focuses on gentle exfoliation to remove dead skin cells and improve overall skin texture, leading to a brighter complexion and better skincare product absorption.

morning_steps.action: Cleanse face with a gentle cleanser
morning_steps.purpose: Pre-cleansing to remove impurities and prepare the skin for exfoliation

night_steps.action: Cleanse face with a gentle cleanser
night_steps.purpose: Pre-cleansing to remove impurities and prepare the skin for exfoliation

weekly_steps.action: Apply a chemical or physical exfoliant, depending on your skin type, to remove dead skin cells

do: Choose an appropriate exfoliant for your skin type (e.g., sensitive, oily, combination, dry)
Pat the product into the skin with gentle circular motions
Allow the exfoliant to work for the recommended time
dont: Over-exfoliate as this can irritate the skin and lead to redness or dryness
Skip the pre-cleansing step; it’s important for effective exfoliation
Use harsh scrubs on sensitive or damaged skin
common_mistakes: Using too strong an exfoliant for one's skin type, leading to irritation and redness
Failing to thoroughly cleanse the skin before applying an exfoliant
Over-exfoliating, which can strip the skin of its natural oils and lead to dryness
best_products_categories: Gentle physical exfoliants with small, round particles
Non-comedogenic products for those prone to breakouts

expected_results.2_weeks: Visible improvement in skin texture and tone; improved product absorption
expected_results.1_month: Reduced appearance of fine lines and wrinkles; smoother and more even skin
expected_results.3_months: Hydrated, brighter complexion with enhanced radiance

expert_tips: Patch test new products before incorporating them into your routine
Stay hydrated by drinking plenty of water daily
Protect your skin from environmental stressors like sun and wind
